1.overview: The elder greets Gaius, rejoices in his faithfulness to the truth, and commends his hospitality toward traveling brothers who serve the Name. He condemns Diotrephes’ rejection of the elder’s authority and refusal to welcome the brothers, commends Demetrius, and closes with plans to meet Gaius and greetings.

sections.heading: Greeting and Joy in Gaius’s Faithfulness
